t: Some Hard Truths About DVC - DVC Fan
s: August 31, 2024 - While those resorts are amazing, and I love them, I wouldn’t purchase there unless I was planning on using my points there because those resorts have the highest dues of all the DVC properties. For 2024, the dues at Vero Beach (for contracts purchased after 1996) are $13.86 per point. By contrast, the dues at the Grand Floridian for 2024 are only $7.57 per point. ... So while you may be tempted to buy a contract that has a lower initial purchase price, do the math to make sure it actually saves you money over the entire life of the contract when dues are figured in.
